g.text: CSA2's three modes: what a layer computes, and what it borrows
core attention over selected main KV + SWA KV
Owns a cache. Layers 2, 8, 14, 20 in V4.1-Flash.
Layer 20's KV is projected from the encoder output (CED).
core attention over selected main KV + SWA KV
No cache of its own, but its own selection.
core attention over selected main KV + SWA KV
No cache, no indexer: 26 of the 38 CSA2 layers.
The report: 15 kernels in prefill, 11 in decode.
green: computed in this layer yellow: cache reused from the most recent Full layer red: indices reused from the most recent Full or Reindex layer
